app.name: evo-agents hub
app.description: The team's shared store for memories, skills, plans and knowledge graphs.

login.title: Sign in
login.heading: Sign in to evo-agents hub
login.description: Use your GitHub account. The hub reads only your GitHub login and never stores a GitHub token.
login.notConfigured: Web sign-in is not enabled on this hub. An administrator needs to set the client secret, the session secret and the hub's public URL.
login.unreachable: The hub API cannot be reached. Reload the page in a few minutes.
login.access: You only see the projects an administrator has granted to your account.
login.cli: On your machine, sign the CLI in with evo-agents hub login.

projectSwitcher.label: Projects
projectSwitcher.none: No project has been granted to you yet
projectSwitcher.loadError: The project list could not be loaded
projectSwitcher.hint: Open a project to see its content

userMenu.grants: {count, plural, =0 {No project grants yet} one {Granted on # project} other {Granted on # projects}}
userMenu.logoutFailed: Sign-out did not go through. Try again in a moment.

home.title: My projects
home.description: The projects the hub returns for your account, with your role and the highest label level you may see.
home.count: {count, plural, =0 {No projects} one {# project} other {# projects}}
home.emptyTitle: No project has been granted to you yet
home.emptyDescription: Ask a hub administrator to grant a role to {login}, then reload this page.

project.title: Project overview
project.noHarness: The project was registered without its harness paths.
project.adminWithoutGrant: You are a hub administrator without a role in this project: you can manage it but cannot read its content.

ladder.title: Label ladder
ladder.description: Levels from lowest to highest. You see content labelled up to your max level.

repos.title: Repos
repos.description: The repos declared in the project's harness.
repos.name: Repo

sinks.title: Sinks
sinks.description: Where the project's content may go, with the highest label level allowed there.

admin.title: Hub administration
admin.description: The number of rows in each hub table. Only hub administrators can see this page.

states.forbiddenTitle: You do not have access to this page
states.forbiddenDescription: The hub API refused the request for your account. If you need access, ask a hub administrator for a suitable role.
states.notFoundDescription: This page does not exist, or it belongs to a project you cannot see.
states.projectNotFoundDescription: The project is not registered on the hub, or you have not been granted access to it.
states.serverErrorTitle: The hub failed to handle the request
states.serverErrorDescription: Try again in a few minutes. If it keeps failing, send the request id below to an administrator.
states.networkErrorTitle: The hub API cannot be reached
states.networkErrorDescription: Check your connection and try again.
states.clientErrorTitle: The API did not accept the request
states.unexpectedDescription: Reload the page. If it keeps failing, send the reference below to an administrator.

memories.projectDescription: Claude Code memory files that members pushed to the hub from the project's harness and repos.
memories.personalDescription: Memories in directories outside every hub project, kept in step across your machines.
memories.projectVisibility: You see memories labelled up to {level}, as your grant allows. User and Feedback memories are visible to their author only.
memories.adminWithoutGrant: You are a hub admin without a grant on this project, so its memories are not readable to you. Ask a project admin for a grant if you need them.
memories.caption: Memories
memories.captionSearch: Memory search results, best match first

summary.all: {count, plural, =0 {No memories} one {# memory} other {# memories}}
summary.search: {count, plural, =0 {No results} one {# result} other {# results}} for “{q}”

memories.truncated: There are more memories than this page loads: showing the first {count}. Use search to find the others.

empty.projectTitle: This project has no memories yet
empty.projectDescription: Memories appear here once members run evo-agents hub memory push in the project's harness or one of its repos.
empty.personalTitle: You have no personal memories yet
empty.personalDescription: Memories in directories outside the hub's projects are pushed with evo-agents hub memory push --all.

noResults.searchDescription: Try other words, fewer filters, or put a phrase in double quotes. Memories labelled above your grant never show here.
noResults.filterDescription: Remove the location or type filter to see more.

markdown.inertLink: The link {target} does not open on the web

detail.title: Memory
detail.notFoundDescription: This memory does not exist, belongs elsewhere, or is not yours to see.
detail.deletedTitle: This memory was deleted at revision {revision}
detail.deletedDescription: What it held before is still in the revision history.
detail.revisionNotFoundDescription: This revision does not exist, or its label is above your grant.
detail.oldTitle: Viewing revision {revision}; the latest is revision {current}
detail.tombstone: This revision marks the memory as deleted, so it has no content.
detail.emptyBody: The file has nothing besides its frontmatter.
detail.ownerOnly: Only its author sees this memory

history.title: Revision history
history.description: Every push or deletion makes a revision. Revisions labelled above your grant are not listed.
history.moreFailed: Older revisions did not load (status {status}). Try again.

skills.projectDescription: Skills the project's members published; evo-agents hub skills sync installs them into every runtime on a machine.
skills.globalDescription: Skills the hub admins published for every member.
skills.onGitHub: (opens the commit on GitHub in a new tab)

empty.projectTitle: This project has no skills yet
empty.projectDescription: Members with the writer role publish one with evo-agents hub skills publish DIR --scope project:{project}.
empty.globalTitle: The hub has no shared skills yet
empty.globalDescription: Hub admins publish one with evo-agents hub skills publish DIR.

summary.all: {count, plural, =0 {No skills} one {# skill} other {# skills}}

noResults.title: No skills match “{q}”
noResults.description: Try other words, or clear the filter to see them all.

blobStore.unconfiguredTitle: The hub has no blob store
blobStore.unconfiguredDescription: Bundles cannot be downloaded because the hub runs without a blob store (R2). Ask a hub admin to set the EVO_HUB_S3_* variables. Versions and their SHA-256 are still listed.
blobStore.unavailableTitle: The blob store is not answering
blobStore.unavailableDescription: Downloading a bundle may fail right now. Try again in a few minutes.

download.forbidden: You may not download this bundle. Ask a project admin for a grant.
download.notFound: This version is no longer on the hub. Reload the page for the current list.
download.unavailable: The hub's blob store is not ready, so the download did not start. Try again later, or tell a hub admin.
download.network: The hub API could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
download.unconfigured: The hub has no blob store

detail.notFoundDescription: This skill has not been published here, or its name is spelled differently.
detail.noVersions: This skill has no versions yet.
detail.latestDescription: A bundle is the tar.gz of the skill directory, exactly as it was published.
detail.verify: Check the download: shasum -a 256 {file} must print the SHA-256 above.
detail.versionsDescription: {count, plural, one {# version} other {# versions}}, latest first.
